deleteDialog.title: Delete account
deleteDialog.body: Your account and all your data will be deleted: subjects, study sessions, exams and grades, quick notes, and the files in your backpack. This action cannot be undone.
deleteDialog.passwordHintGoogle: This account signed in with Google. Log out, sign back in, and try again.

errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

notificationsSheet.title: Notifications
notificationsSheet.subtitleWeb: Safari only lets you turn on alerts from an installed app.
notificationsSheet.subtitleDefault: This is everything we can send you. Nothing else.
notificationsSheet.installTitle: Add it to your home screen
notificationsSheet.installBody: Tap the Share icon in Safari and choose "Add to Home Screen". When you open it from there, we'll ask for permission automatically.
notificationsSheet.footer: The switch turns them all on or off together. Choosing them individually is coming later.

exam.title: Exam alerts
exam.body: Three days before and the night before, in the morning. Several exams on the same day arrive as a single alert.

reengagement.title: Get back to it
reengagement.body: If you go four days without opening the app. At most one a week, and without guilt-tripping you.

weekly.title: Weekly summary
weekly.body: Sunday nights, with what you studied that week. Only if you did at least one session.
